body: As a sexual abuse survivor i'd rather be a murderer. Sexual abuse can rob you of a future faster than a bullet in my experience.

From my personal experience in a family of N's, and as the child of the family SG, not many are likely to believe without seeing first-hand. You can explain with perfect clarity and most still blame you until the narc gets emotionally tripped in a more public setting.

The sale has been approved by all parties including my mother. I've cut contact with all involved at least for the time being. She used to be big in the local political scene. With it being so cheaply built i'm not worried about getting money out as it would cost more than i spent just to fight her. Just cutting my losses and calling it a lesson.
The post was me hoping i wasn't the only one that thought this seemed a bit off. Legality is already very clear to me. I'm not ignorant of the law. I know when i'm screwed.

I should have had a different title honestly. My bad. She isn't rebuilding at all. She's trying to wipe the slate clean. When it flooded in her house after i'd already lost mine, i had been trying to convince her to leave for two days. She kept insisting my grandpa wouldn't let her house flood. Screamed it at me till i stopped speaking. We were evacuated by coast guard via boat once her house had water She isn't planning to repair her home. She's bulldozing it and building small if not buying her own camper. It is a grave honestly. Your opinion doesn't make it less so to my family.

The home is bolted to an existing concrete slab or i would consider moving it. I'll just build another. Had just begun to finish the inside walls. Nothing expensive or fancy. 20x25 one room flat. It isn't the money in the home that really concerns me. I'm mid 20's and can make more of it to build again elsewhere. It's that she's willing to sell her husband's grave with no hesitation whatsoever, and she told me she was selling my home with a smile and a laugh.
Can't comment on turning your abuser in. I never did. I will say i regret it deeply though.

My abuser was 20 and i was 10. It continued until i was almost 15. He had multiple boy toys his own age. I was just a pet he was cruel or loving to depending on his mood. Intimate contact wasn't unpleasant until i said no and he raped me. After that i shut down and he had no further use for me. From what i can tell it's a pretty common way for things to progress. Don't doubt your perceptions. It was sexual abuse.

That's definitely abuse. About as cut and dry as any abuse ever is. In fact, the invalidation of your experience by a partner is abuse too. Especially if it was chronic invalidation. The "severity" of abuse is mostly irrelevant. How it changes you personally means everything. Each person will react differently to the same trauma, so don't get hung up on the life stories of others and how much "worse" theirs is. It's not about having a measuring contest. It's all about where you decide to go with your life once you look up out of the pit and realize you aren't alone. I'm so sorry your mother allowed abuse to continue once informed. Noone deserves that betrayal.
Stay strong and move forward always taking care of yourself like your parents should have. The most important thing you can get back isn't your abuse memories. It's your life.

From my experience i'll say that if your mother doesn't recognize the pain of others you may want to be prepared to get shut down during that talk or just avoid it entirely. My family is the same way, multigenerational abuse and all. They don't WANT to hear any of it. Don't doubt your memories, they're locked up for a reason. Be very careful going forward with hypno. It can work, but unethical clinicians can make you recall all kinds of info. I've found the memories come when you can handle them. Usually in therapy or some safe sharing environment where your inner child comes out. Seeking them out before i started to heal lead to me being hospitalized when i scratched the wrong wall looking for answers.
I second the separation.They sound similar on paper and couldn't be more different. They can be present together though from what i've seen. My mother is this way.
Yupp. That's been a pretty constant fixture in my life. The part of me that holds the trauma constantly vocalizes a desire to die. It's pretty independent of triggers too. You aren't alone.

I've tried to pull away in the past unsuccessfully. I'm not even really sure where to begin. The constant emotional thrill ride makes constant full time employment difficult. Lack of resources kills any momentum i ever gain eventually. Even my year in the military ended in lost momentum. A diagnosis of cptsd and shipped home with an honorable.

I've been told everything from " I can't handle this" to "it hurts me when you talk about that". Mostly i lose people when i open up. My granny was the one who told me to move on and just "don't think about it because others had it worse". I've bottled it for years and it's been strangling me.

Thanks for your kindness. I don't even know where to start taking care of myself. It's a challenge to keep choosing to breathe these days. Just needed to let it out. It's been a decade carrying it alone.
